tx-denton-2026-dj467-jones-derbha.name: Derbha Jones
tx-denton-2026-dj467-jones-derbha.bio: Presiding judge of the 467th District Court and the Denton County Family Drug Treatment Court; practiced law for 18 years before her appointment.

tx-denton-2026-dj481-levonius-crystal.name: Crystal Edmonson Levonius
tx-denton-2026-dj481-levonius-crystal.bio: Judge of the 481st Judicial District Court since 2022; former Collin County prosecutor for 15 years.

tx-denton-2026-ccrim2-piel-susan.name: Susan Piel
tx-denton-2026-ccrim2-piel-susan.bio: Former Denton County assistant district attorney and division chief; attorney in private practice.

tx-denton-2026-probate1-jahn-david.name: David Jahn
tx-denton-2026-probate1-jahn-david.bio: Former associate judge of the Denton County Probate Court and presiding judge of Denton County Criminal Court at Law No. 1; former U.S. Army pilot.

tx-fort-bend-2026-coa14-chief-jewell-kev.name: Kevin Jewell
tx-fort-bend-2026-coa14-chief-jewell-kev.bio: Justice on the Fourteenth Court of Appeals since 2016; former litigation and appellate shareholder at a Houston law firm.

positions.stance: Says he will "never legislate from my seat on the bench" and was elected "to apply the law as written and to never privilege one party over another."
"I believe a judge's core job is to deliver justice for all and give all parties the fair day in court they deserve."

tx-fort-bend-2026-coa14-chief-landau-sar.name: Sarah Beth Landau
tx-fort-bend-2026-coa14-chief-landau-sar.bio: Justice on the First Court of Appeals from 2019 to 2024; former federal public defender and Harris County Public Defender's Office attorney.

tx-fort-bend-2026-coa1-p3-frankfort-todd.name: Todd Frankfort
tx-fort-bend-2026-coa1-p3-frankfort-todd.bio: Houston attorney with more than 30 years of legal experience.

positions.stance: Shares "the conservative values of judicial restraint and strict interpretation of the laws as written" and "will not allow judges to legislate from the bench."

tx-fort-bend-2026-coa1-p3-rivas-molloy-v.name: Veronica Rivas-Molloy
tx-fort-bend-2026-coa1-p3-rivas-molloy-v.bio: Justice on the First Court of Appeals with 25 years of combined legal experience.

tx-fort-bend-2026-coa1-p4-gunn-david.name: David Gunn
tx-fort-bend-2026-coa1-p4-gunn-david.bio: Justice on the First Court of Appeals, appointed by Governor Greg Abbott; former appellate lawyer at Beck Redden LLP.

positions.stance: Philosophy "founded on a commitment to interpret the law faithfully and impartially, with a deep respect for the letter and spirit of the constitution."

tx-fort-bend-2026-coa1-p4-countiss-julie.name: Julie Countiss
tx-fort-bend-2026-coa1-p4-countiss-julie.bio: Former justice of the First Court of Appeals with six years of service on the court.

tx-fort-bend-2026-coa1-p5-caird-jessica.name: Jessica Caird
tx-fort-bend-2026-coa1-p5-caird-jessica.bio: Harris County assistant district attorney and appellate division chief.

positions.stance: Believes the U.S. and Texas Constitutions "must be interpreted as written because they stand as the will of the people."
"The job of a judge is not to ignore or create the law, but to faithfully apply it as written by the Texas Legislature."

tx-fort-bend-2026-coa1-p5-guerra-amy.name: Amy Guerra
tx-fort-bend-2026-coa1-p5-guerra-amy.bio: Justice on the Texas First Court of Appeals since 2020; former civil litigator and part-time City of Houston municipal judge.

tx-fort-bend-2026-coa14-p7-wise-ken.name: Ken Wise
tx-fort-bend-2026-coa14-p7-wise-ken.bio: Justice on the 14th Court of Appeals since 2013; former judge of the 334th and 152nd District Courts in Harris County.

tx-fort-bend-2026-coa14-p7-demond-willia.name: William Demond
tx-fort-bend-2026-coa14-p7-demond-willia.bio: Former constitutional rights attorney in Houston who became a staff attorney for the Fifth District Court of Appeals in 2023.

tx-fort-bend-2026-dist-240-reddi-asha.name: Asha Reddi
tx-fort-bend-2026-dist-240-reddi-asha.bio: Attorney with more than 34 years of legal experience and 8 years of judicial service.

tx-fort-bend-2026-dist-240-pattel-surend.name: Surendran K. Pattel
tx-fort-bend-2026-dist-240-pattel-surend.bio: Judge of the 240th District Court in Fort Bend County since 2023; former attorney in India and Texas.

positions.stance: "A judge's responsibility is not to create laws or pursue politics — it is to faithfully apply the law with fairness and integrity."
Says decisions are "guided solely by the Constitution, Texas statutes, and established case law," free from political pressure.

tx-fort-bend-2026-dist-268-rogers-steve.name: Steve Rogers
tx-fort-bend-2026-dist-268-rogers-steve.bio: Judge of the 268th District Court in Fort Bend County; practiced law in state and federal courts from 2003.

positions.stance: "A judge's duty is to follow the law as it is written, apply it fairly, and protect the integrity of our justice system."

tx-fort-bend-2026-dist-268-scott-brendet.name: Brendetta Scott
tx-fort-bend-2026-dist-268-scott-brendet.bio: Attorney with 25+ years of practice and adjunct professor at Thurgood Marshall School of Law.
